notes.title: Update: V0.3a
notes.notes:
Update: V0.3a

New Features & Changes

 Simplified menu (tutorials are still based on the old menu).
 Simplified battles on the first map.
 Added summoners to fight in the first part of the story.
 Qualification now works by "number of points" instead of number of victories.
 Added new Akumons.
 Instructors are now much weaker, and each major city has one. Defeating them will allow you to specialize your summoner.
 Reworked clothing shops with preview functionality.
 Added new clothes.
 Modified the Bluetoon cave.
 Ability to jump into the water to capture aquatic Akumons.
 Removed romance points.
 Added new quests.
 Added a laboratory where you can buy the starters you didn’t choose and incubate an egg.


Known Issues

 New outfits do not correctly update the player’s sprite on the map.
 A slowdown may occur on the first map (cause not yet identified).

notes.title: Minor Update 0.2.5
notes.notes:
Fixes (Gamepad & Keyboard)
• Fixed unexpected appearance of phantom buttons.
• Resolved a bug that could lock certain menus when using a gamepad or keyboard.

New Features
• 3 new Akumons to discover and capture!
• Capture counter added to the Akubook (track your progress!).
• Reserve sorting now available (⚠️ mouse only for now).
• Akumons can now be released directly from the reserve.
• Fishing spots added (requires bait, available in some shops).
• New appearance interface to customize the heroine from the main menu.

notes.title: Update V0.2.2: AkuBook
notes.notes: Visual update of the AkuBook with Akumon portraits. This is a temporary version.

notes.title: Update V0.2.1
notes.notes:
Update V0.2.1

• Fixed a bug affecting some players that prevented the day/night cycle from loading correctly when loading a save. (Note: After this update, the first time you load your save, the day/night cycle will reset. This is normal.)
• Improved emotion bubbles.
• Updated Oden's portrait.
• Adjusted the power of Dark-type Akumons.
• Fixed a bug that could cause the player to enter Overground mode in the haunted house if Overground was enabled.

Nerking

notes.title: Update V0.2
notes.notes:
Update V0.2

 Added animations for some characters (more to come).
 New introduction.
 Raven's abilities now work like those of the Akumons: they are purchased with skill points and limited to four.
 Based on player feedback: added grass to delimit Akumon capture zones (except in caves). For snow and sand, the character's feet will now be covered in capture zones, with an animation to indicate it.
 The Overground is available from the start of the adventure.

notes.title: Update V0.1.9
notes.notes:
Update V0.1.9:


 The game has been upgraded to HD format.
 Revamped interface and menus.
 Added animations for status effects.
 Status effects are applied more frequently.
 Added localized (translated) texts in combat to indicate a change in status or type.
 New animation to display relationship gains.


Bug Fixes:

The last update had disabled the ability to transform Shardegg into a Magma-type Shardagon. This issue has been fixed.

Known Bugs:

Following the transition to HD, some attacks on the player's Akumon appear slightly too low.
The sprites of Sankong and Luckon are not properly adapted to HD format and may appear slightly blurry.

notes.title: Update V.0.1.8
notes.notes:
Update V.0.1.8 – New Relationships, New Akumons, and Story Progression

This update introduces several new features that enhance character interactions.

Update Content:


 Added a relationship system with main characters. Your relationship level can now be viewed from the menu.
 Added new relationship events focused on Raven as a child.
 Added two new Akumons (numbers 95 and 96).
 Added a new cave, featuring an event tied to Raven’s story, accessible only with Raven as a child.
 Minor continuation of Raven’s story as an adult.


Important: To fully enjoy these new features, it is recommended to start a new game. You can continue an existing save, but your relationships with characters will be reset to the default level, and one of the new Akumons will not be obtainable.

Thank you for your support, and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Update v0.1.7
notes.notes:
• Added quests for young Raven.
• Added Italian language support.
• Elite Summoners are now much more powerful.
• New game introduction.

notes.title: Update v0.1.6: "Egg"
notes.notes:
Bug Fixes:

• Akumons no longer transfer between save files when returning to the menu.
• The night effect no longer applies to battles.
• In-game time now loads correctly when resuming a game.
• Reduced the frequency of rain.

New Features:

• Akumon Breeding System: Two Akumons of the same type can fall in love and produce an egg (which can be incubated at Stillpeak or in your apartment). Newborns are stronger than their parents at the same level and inherit personality traits as well as techniques from them.
• Egg Incubation: The incubation time for an egg is 20 real-time minutes (in-game or out of the game).
• Egg Display: The presence of an egg is indicated by an icon at the top right of the screen.
• More Dangerous Nights: Akumons encountered at night are stronger.
• Serious Injury System: When an Akumon is defeated, it may suffer a serious injury. These can only be healed by a healer (available in D-Shops).
• Mood & Relationship Display: Added icons to show an Akumon's mood and friendship towards you, as well as if it has a romantic partner.
• Enhanced Day/Night Cycle: Added an image representing the time of day.
• Game Time: One in-game day equals 45 real-time minutes. (The tent allows you to speed up time if needed).
• Nighttime Atmosphere: New battle background for night battles.
• Quest System: Implemented a quest system.
• UI Improvements:
o The Return to Menu option is now included in the Quit command to prevent misclicks.
o New title screen background.
• Customization: You can now rename an Akumon.

notes.title: Update V0.1.5: "Akubot"
notes.notes:
New Features and Changes:


 Added a day-night cycle.
 Resting in a tent now consumes hours.
 D-shops are now closed at night.
 Added a weather system.
 Reduced the power of Dark-type Akumon attacks. However, they will be stronger at night.
 Fire-type attacks are weaker in rainy weather.
 Water-type attacks are stronger in rainy weather.
 Tagemon will now appear during snowy weather.
 The action "Capture an Akumon" is no longer part of Raven's abilities but is directly accessible in the command menu.
 Continued Raven's story (new town available).
 Buyable apartment in Hopea (not fully furnished yet) once Raven becomes an adult.
 Possibility to obtain an Akubot.
 Added a new Akumon (number 94).
 Snelec and Moonto's abilities can trigger unique mutations in three new Akumons (Redfire, Sankey, and Nocturo).
 Added the ability to return to the title screen.
 Added new Steam achievements.


The creation of the time and weather system may have introduced bugs that I might have missed. The previous version of the game will remain available in the "old version" branch just in case.

For the next update:


 Addition of a quest system.
 New battle backgrounds.
 Implementation of an egg incubation system.
 More unique abilities for Akumons.


Thank you again for your feedback and suggestions.

Nerking

notes.title: Update: V0.1.4: Tree of Life
notes.notes:
- Added a Rank B Akumon and a Rank A Akumon.

- Added an event: Tree of Life
→ Allows you to capture Foxon (North of Greenhaven, unlockable during Raven's adult phase after completing the mission involving the manipulator).

- Added three outfits
→ One outfit is only available for adult Raven and can be purchased in Merchoria.

- Added three achievements related to the Tree of Life event.

Best regards,
Nerking

notes.title: Update V0.1.3
notes.notes:

Have a nice day,

Best regards
